about_short_description.short_description: Workflow software for solar & energy contractors

product.name: Project Management
product.description: A system to manage solar projects from sale to installation, tracking timelines, milestones, and storing project documents with mobile app access for field teams.

product.name: Asset Monitoring
product.description: A tool for real-time tracking of solar system performance, including equipment health and alert notifications for anomalies across multiple sites.

product.name: Operations & Maintenance
product.description: A system to manage maintenance tasks, preventive scheduling, work orders, inventory, and homeowner memberships for solar installations.

product.name: Coperniq CRM
product.description: A solar-specific CRM for managing contacts, sales pipelines, projects, and automated customer communications.

product.name: Coperniq Mobile App
product.description: A mobile application for field teams to access project details, complete digital forms, capture GPS-tagged photos, and sync updates in real time.

product.name: Homeowner Portal
product.description: A white-labeled portal for solar system owners to monitor energy production, access support, view documents, and track service status in real time.
